WELCOME, SPACE EXPLORER

The universe is your playground.

Walk all the way around eight tiny planets! Turn on your jetpack and fly wherever you want. Drag to aim, then fly forward. Let go of the controls to hover. Touch any planet or New Moon to land, or use the Land button when you’re close. Follow the golden stardust and try each planet’s bouncy launch pad.

WASD / arrows
Walk or fly
Space / ↑
Jump, or hold to fly up
Shift / C / ↓
Hold to fly down
E / action button
Take off / land nearby
Drag / swipe
Look around / aim your flight
Scroll / pinch
Zoom

New Moon throws rocks, asteroids and meteorites. When an orange target appears, move away or jump just before the rock arrives. A hit sends you to the sun: “Oh, that’s hot, hot, hot!” A cooling comet always brings you safely back. No lives to lose.

Land on New Moon to become his captain! He fires eight asteroids and meteorites at the sun. Each hit shrinks it until the lights go out. Your helmet light helps you explore in the dark. “Bring back the sun” restores daylight and returns you to Earth, keeping your discoveries.

These are playful toy planets, with pretend gravity and surfaces—even on the gas giants. Your discoveries last for this visit. Turn on sound for little chimes and a talking astronaut.
